payload.problem: Medium-range forecasts need sharp, calibrated ensembles.
payload.method: A conditional diffusion model trained on ERA5 reanalysis.
key_findings: The model produces sharp ensemble forecasts at 0.25 degree resolution.
limitations: The abstract reports no skill score against operational baselines.
reusable_ideas: Conditional diffusion can be applied to reanalysis data directly.

evidence.quote: We introduce a conditional diffusion model for medium-range weather forecasting

payload.relevance: This is the closest match to the topic: a conditional diffusion model trained directly on reanalysis data for medium-range forecasts.
